strategy.summary: Complete 1 through 5 repeatedly by sending the ball through the wider bumper gaps, open the upper-right return gate early, and let bumper action collect center rollovers instead of shooting them directly.

quickInfo.name: Number set
quickInfo.summary: Completing 1 through 5 scores 300 points on Doozie, and incomplete sets carry between balls.

quickInfo.name: Two-number plunge
quickInfo.summary: A good plunge takes the top 5 rollover and then one needed lane from 1 through 4.

quickInfo.name: Open Gate target
quickInfo.summary: The upper-left standup opens the upper-right gate so later balls can return to the plunger lane.

quickInfo.name: Center-gap route
quickInfo.summary: On Doozie, the gaps between the center and side bumpers are wider than the outside paths and are the preferred routes up top.

quickInfo.name: Zipper flippers
quickInfo.summary: Closed flippers can make trapping and microflip setup easier, but the Close Flippers standups are too dangerous to chase routinely.

steps.text: Read which of numbers 1 through 5 are missing before the plunge.
Plunge through the top 5 rollover and then a missing lane from 1 through 4; choose 1 when every lower number is currently unlit.
During the first bumper sequence, use only a legal, controlled nudge toward the upper-left Open Gate target.
From either flipper, send the ball through a wide center gap between the bumpers.
Let bumper action and downward feeds collect needed center rollovers naturally.
When the upper-right gate is open, accept its plunger-lane return and use the next plunge to collect another needed number.
If the zipper flippers close incidentally, trap the ball and Micro flip into the next center-gap shot.
After completing 1 through 5, read the reset lamps and repeat the route.

fallback.title: Closed-flipper control
fallback.when: Use this plan when upper-playfield exits repeatedly reach the slingshots or side drains.

steps.text: Do not shoot a Close Flippers target deliberately after an unsafe rebound.
When the flippers close through natural play, let the ball settle across the zipped pair.
Micro flip toward the flipper with the safer upper angle.
Send the ball through the nearest wide center gap.
Resume number-set play only after the return is controlled.

alternatives.title: Lit center-bumper repeat
alternatives.when: Use this plan only when the center bumper is lit for 100 and the zipper flippers are already closed.

steps.text: Settle the ball on the closed flippers.
Use a short, centered flip toward the lit 100-point bumper.
Track the bumper rebound before repeating.
Abandon the repeat as soon as the return reaches a side sling or opens the flippers.
Collect 5 and one needed lower number on the plunge.
Hit the upper-left standup to open the upper-right return gate when bumper action presents it.
Use center-gap upper feeds to collect the remaining numbers.
Complete the set for its main award.
Repeat while preserving any partial set across balls.

techniques.name: Two-number skill shot
techniques.instruction: Plunge hard enough to reach the 5 rollover, then guide the descending ball toward a needed lane from 1 through 4.

techniques.name: Center-gap upper feed
techniques.instruction: Aim between the center bumper and a side bumper. Favor a clean gap entry over a direct hit on the underside of a bumper.

techniques.name: Micro flip
techniques.instruction: Micro flip only after the ball settles across the closed zipper flippers and the next upper-shot angle is ready.

cautions.issue: A direct shot at a center rollover can strike the underside of a bumper and drain.
cautions.response: Send the ball up a center gap and let bumper action collect the rollover on the way down.

cautions.issue: The Close Flippers standups are narrow and produce dangerous rebounds.
cautions.response: Do not chase them. Use zipper-flipper control only when the flippers close incidentally.

cautions.issue: Most upper feeds return through a slingshot or toward a side drain.
cautions.response: Track every top exit with both flippers ready and stop repeating any lane whose return cannot be controlled.

strategy.simpleOverview: Doozie / Daffie carries incomplete progress on numbers 1 through 5 between balls. Plunge through 5 and one missing lower lane, use the wider center gaps to return upstairs, and let bumper action collect center rollovers while the upper-right gate provides another plunge.
strategy.overview: Doozie / Daffie repeats a numbered upper-playfield cycle supported by the upper-right return gate and zipper flippers. Use the plunge for two needed numbers, open the gate through natural bumper action, then keep feeding the wide center gaps. Accept incidental closed-flipper control, but do not chase the dangerous Close Flippers standups.
